base_member_text: L1566-L1570: in the ISWAVE == 4 branch, var 18 ('Diss', catalog wave_dissipation @L116) is filled from WV_Global(L).FREQ (L1568) - the same source used for 'Tp' (L1563-L1565); the relation between dissipation output and FREQ is not stated in this file.
audit_member_text: Wave dissipation is a copy/paste value error: array1d is filled from WV_Global(L).FREQ at L1567-L1569 immediately before writing variable 18 `Diss` at L1570. The same FREQ source was already used for peak period at L1563-L1565, so the dissipation variable receives frequency data with incompatible meaning/units.
dispositions.rationale: wave var 18 'Diss' filled from WV_Global.FREQ — same source as Tp
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: nc_write_bed_2d declares str2d(2) but cnt2d(3) (L1321) and passes a 2-element start with 3-element count to nf90_put_var @L1349; whether this start/count rank mismatch is intended is not resolvable from this file.
audit_member_text: nc_write_bed_2d writes rank-3 variables using str2d declared with length 2 at L1321 and set to `(1,time_idx)` at L1323, while cnt2d has three entries and includes KB at L1325/L1338. The layer start index is omitted, so HBED/BDENBED/PORBED writes at L1592-L1594 have a start/count interface mismatch.
dispositions.rationale: nc_write_bed_2d: 2-element start with 3-element count (KB layer) — start/count rank mismatch
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: Sigma-Z metadata names a nonexistent/inconsistent depth coordinate: the IGRIDV branch writes `depth: Bottom` at L562, while the same file defines bottom elevation as BELV and the standard-sigma branch uses `depth: BELV` at L577.
dispositions.rationale: Sigma-Z depth attr 'Bottom' vs 'BELV' across branches

audit_member_text: The generic def_var routine always attaches coordinates `Mesh2D_face_y Mesh2D_face_x`, mesh `Mesh2D`, and grid_mapping `crs` at L1035-L1057. nc_create_hf_file defines only cell/col/row/lon/lat/name at L739-L770 and no Mesh2D or crs variables, then invokes def_time_vars at L774; high-frequency files therefore contain dangling coordinate, mesh, and grid-mapping references.
dispositions.rationale: hf file lacks Mesh2D/crs vars but def_var attaches those coords — dangling refs
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: Inactive component counts are passed directly as fixed dimension lengths (NDYE, NTOX, NSED, NSND, NSEDS2, NALGAE, NZOOPL, NSF, NQCTL, NQWR) at L726-L736 and similarly in the full-grid creator at L443-L453. Since the NetCDF unlimited length is zero, any inactive count of zero can create unintended unlimited dimensions rather than an absent/zero-length class dimension; compatibility and downstream shapes are unresolved.
dispositions.rationale: inactive component counts as fixed dim lengths; zero -> unintended unlimited dim
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: The RSSBC array is dimensioned for LCM_Global and filled through LCM_Global at L665-L679, then written with count LCM_Global-1 at L680, whereas CUV and the face mesh use nc.cellcnt/LA_Global-1 at L636-L672. If LCM_Global exceeds LA_Global, this write exceeds the defined face dimension or associates ghost cells with active faces.
dispositions.rationale: RSSBC written count LCM_Global-1 vs face dim LA_Global-1
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: For high-frequency output with IJHFRE(IS) other than zero, lon and lat remain MISSING_VALUE because coordinate assignment is wholly inside IJHFRE(IS)==0 at L790-L806, even though cell indices are populated unconditionally at L808-L814. The intended coordinate source for that mode is not present here.
dispositions.rationale: hf lon/lat stay MISSING when IJHFRE(IS)!=0
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: nc_write_wc_2d initializes `values` only in the full-grid branch at L1247-L1254. In the high-frequency branch L1234-L1245, Sigma-Z layers below KSZ_Global are never assigned, so uninitialized memory is written for those layers.
dispositions.rationale: nc_write_wc_2d hf branch leaves Sigma-Z layers below KSZ unassigned

audit_member_text: LAYERACTIVE is stored as int2d(cell,KB) at L1626-L1635, but nf90_put_var is given count `(KB,nc.cellcnt,1)` at L1636. The first two dimensions are reversed relative to both the allocation and other cell-layer writers, causing a shape/count mismatch unless the two lengths happen to match.
dispositions.rationale: LAYERACTIVE put_var count (KB,cellcnt,1) reverses first two dims
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: In the non-LSEDZLJ exposed-bed branch, TOXB is defined through ncvar(30) with the bed-layer/component layout in def_time_vars at L932-L940, but only a cell-by-NTOX surface array is passed to nc_write_wc_2d at L1733-L1741. That helper loops its second index from KSZ_Global through KC at L1241-L1244, not 1 through NTOX, so it can index beyond array2d/values and cannot satisfy the bed variable rank.
dispositions.rationale: TOXB bed-layer var fed a cell-by-NTOX surface via vertical-layer helper
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: All cell-by-shellfish-class variables 143-154 are passed to nc_write_wc_2d at L1901-L1975. That water-column helper allocates second extent NSF but loops k=KSZ_Global(L)..KC at L1241-L1244. When KC and NSF differ this reads/writes outside the class array or leaves class slots unset; these calls should use a class-oriented cell writer rather than a vertical-layer writer.
dispositions.rationale: shellfish class vars use water-column helper (loops KSZ..KC not 1..NSF)
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: The wave radiation-stress descriptors Sxx/Sxy/Syy are labelled W/m2 in the nc_var table at L117-L119, while the variables are populated directly from WVHUU_Global/WVHUV_Global/WVHVV_Global at L1571-L1573 without any documented conversion. Whether those source arrays actually have energy-flux units rather than radiation-stress units is unresolved and should be reconciled with their producers.
dispositions.rationale: Sxx/Sxy/Syy labelled W/m2 but from WVHUU/WVHUV/WVHVV without conversion
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: File-open state is not synchronized with actual close behavior. nc_close_file closes only when ncdfout>1 at L1080-L1088 but never clears isopen; nc_output and nc_output_hf always call it at L2088/L2117 and on the next call reopen whenever isopen==1 at L2060-L2062/L2108-L2109. For ncdfout<=1 this reopens an already-open file; for ncdfout>1 isopen continues to describe a closed handle.
dispositions.rationale: nc_close_file never clears isopen — reopen/close state desync
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: At a date rollover in split-file mode, the `isopen==1` branch calls nc_write on nc(0) at L2075-L2077 before creating the new file. Under the ncdfout>1 path the preceding invocation closed that handle at L2088, so the rollover write targets a closed NetCDF id and can stop in a checked writer; under a persistent-open path it duplicates the transition timestep into the prior file before also writing it to the new file at L2087.
dispositions.rationale: date rollover writes nc(0) to a closed handle before creating new file
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

audit_member_text: Most direct NetCDF operations in def_var and nc_write assign status without check_err (for example L1026-L1064, L1467-L1469, L1980-L2031), while helper-based writes stop on error. This inconsistent error contract can let failed definitions, attributes, time writes, or structure outputs proceed with invalid ids and surface only in later operations.
dispositions.rationale: most direct NetCDF ops omit check_err — inconsistent error contract
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)
